correctness.rationale: In G_{m,r}, where the two hubs are nonadjacent and the opposite part is a matching plus isolates, orient each matching edge once and join edges toward hubs for n≥3 to obtain maximum reachable set size four (three without matched edges); reverse joins for n≤2. Koana–Oh–Yoneda acyclic reachability implies stable-colour upper bounds. An explicit ranking profile on G_{1,1} blocks all 12 proper named three-colour assignments via a mutual-envy pair; subgraph monotonicity extends the 4 lower bound. The ordinary triangle/K_{2,n} cases give other lower bounds; a neighbor-colour counting proof shows Grundy=3 on the matched n≥3 family. Independently enumerated 6^5=7776 ranking profiles against all 12 assignments and classified exactly 624 with no acyclic envy graph: 576 unavoidable 2-cycles plus 48 with longer cycles only. This is exhaustive for labelled G_{1,1} with exactly three colors, not for all graph sizes.
